name: bun-svelte-photoblog

scripts.dev:israel: CONTENT_DIR=israel-2022 bun run images:build --manifestOnly && CONTENT_DIR=israel-2022 bun run favicons:build && CONTENT_DIR=israel-2022 vite dev
scripts.dev:egypt: CONTENT_DIR=egypt-2025 bun run images:build --manifestOnly && CONTENT_DIR=egypt-2025 bun run favicons:build && CONTENT_DIR=egypt-2025 vite dev
scripts.build:israel: CONTENT_DIR=israel-2022 bun run images:build && CONTENT_DIR=israel-2022 bun run favicons:build && CONTENT_DIR=israel-2022 OUTPUT_DIR=build-israel-2022 vite build
scripts.build:egypt: CONTENT_DIR=egypt-2025 bun run images:build && CONTENT_DIR=egypt-2025 bun run favicons:build && CONTENT_DIR=egypt-2025 OUTPUT_DIR=build-egypt-2025 vite build
scripts.generate: bun run images:build && bun run favicons:build
scripts.test: sh -c 'bun run test:unit -- "$@"' -- && bun run test:e2e
scripts.test:images: SHARP_NUM_THREADS=1 vitest -c vitest.config.images.ts --run --reporter verbose tests/integration/**/*.spec.ts tests/e2e-images/**/*.spec.ts
scripts.test:all: bun run test:unit:images && bun run test:images
scripts.images:all: bun run images:build && bun run images:blur

_comment_overrides_vite_vitest_type_fix: Forces a single version of the 'vite' package across the entire project. Resolves type conflicts between 'vite' (used directly) and 'vitest' (which brings its own 'vite' dependency), otherwise leading to TypeScript errors.
